extraction_notes: Target identity retained exactly from the extraction job: AO3402, Alpha Omega Semicon, n-channel MOSFET, LCSC C14385.
The PDF title, page headers, and product summary identify AO3402; the datasheet branding is Alpha & Omega Semiconductor.
Figures 1, 2, and 8 contain usable typical curves. Listed curve points are compact direct readings rounded to the plotted grid resolution and are not interpolated.

The strict MOSFET schema has no fields for IDSS, IGSS, ID(ON), gFS, gate charge, switching times, reverse-recovery charge, thermal resistance, absolute maximum ratings, or SOA; those fields were not added outside schema.

The table publishes capacitance minimum, typical, and maximum values; the schema has one field per capacitance, so typical values are retained and the plotted Figure 8 curves preserve the voltage-dependent typical behavior.
The table publishes VSD typical 0.75 V and maximum 1.0 V at IS = 1 A; the schema body_diode field retains the maximum value.
